name: QBZ-95
description:
A shift from earlier Novaruss-inspired designs, the QBZ-95 represents the People's Republic of Jinhan's first domestically developed family of small arms for the new 5.8x42mm round. The design includes a distinctive foregrip positioned just ahead of the pistol grip, improving handling during automatic fire.
 While the bullpup layout offers compactness, the QBZ-95 lacks modularity for mounting accessories - often requiring aftermarket kits to use them.

Community submitted model.
